Name: Sippai
Summary: Of the children of the giant, slain by Sibbechai the Hushathite at Gezer.
KeyStory: Named in 1 Chronicles at 1 Chronicles 20:4: Of the children of the giant, slain by Sibbechai the Hushathite at Gezer.
LifeLesson: The mention of Sippai in 1 Chronicles places this person within the story of God's people under David and his kingdom.
